# T-2: Defer selected record deletion

## Goal
Keep the selected preparing record intact until prepare conversion completes successfully, then delete only that runId.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Successful prepare removes only the selected record after conversion.
- Every failure before completion preserves selected and unrelated record bytes.

## Implementation Notes
Place target deletion after the successful branch/worktree/spec/flow/docs/plugin/registry path. Preserve existing command output and unrelated partial-side-effect recovery behavior.

## Test Strategy
Exercise successful target-only removal and injected validation, agent/plugin, write/docs, and conversion failures with raw-byte snapshots of selected and unrelated records.
